display_long_description:
# 🎲Roll the dice and travel the world – in Mixed Reality!

MR. TRAVELER is a groundbreaking travel-themed game where a giant board game map unfolds right in your own space through mixed reality. All you need is a Meta Quest headset, and your room becomes the starting point of an epic global journey! Dive into wacky mini-games, collect famous landmarks, and experience unpredictable adventures from around the world.

**Key Features:**
- **Travel mates from Gacha**: Use the coins you’ve earned in the game to spin the gacha and collect adorable, one-of-a-kind pawn characters. These characters will become your reliable mates on every journey! [media]

- **Mixed Reality Tabletop Gameplay**: Place the board map freely in your real space. Grab and roll the dice with hand tracking in real time, move your pawn, and enjoy immersive turns like never before. [media]

- **Mini-Games from Around the World**: Play random mini-games at each spot on the map! From Viking whack-a-mole, Rio street soccer, to Roman Colosseum obstacle races — experience fun and excitement through a variety of global challenges. [media]

**Where will your next travel take you?🗺️**

Roll the dice and set out to explore the world. 

MR. TRAVELER — now the world comes to you!
